tool.name: get_project
tool.description: Read the current project, root path, wiring, application workspace and unsaved state.

tool.name: initialize_project
tool.description: Initialize a HardwareHarness project in an existing absolute directory and open it. Refuses existing projects, unsaved changes and active execution.

tool.name: open_project
tool.description: Open an existing HardwareHarness project by absolute directory. Refuses unsaved changes and active execution.

tool.name: save_project
tool.description: Save the current project's application workspace and canvas through the normal project service.
